question: In April 2022, ‘SVANidhi se Samriddhi’ program was launched in additional 126 cities. This program provides ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**social welfare benefits**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri Manoj Joshi, Secretary, Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** launched the ‘SVANidhi se Samriddhi’ program.
 
• **‘SVANidhi se Samriddhi’**, an further program of PMSVANidhi was launched on 4th January 2021 in 125 cities in Phase 1, covering approximately 35 Lakh Street vendors.
 
• MoHUA has been executing **Prime Minister Street Vendors AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)**, a Central Sector Scheme since **1st June 2020**. The scheme strives to provide an affordable working capital loan to Street Vendors
 
• ‘**‘SVANidhi se Samriddhi’ program was started to provide social safety benefits to street vendors for their holistic development and socio-economic upliftment.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/affbc5926007d7456cc3ba96b88729350d9e29175f31f47787d5f6db47b252e5.png]
